compiler.arguments: source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]

evaluator.budget_unit: one explicit source-machine step; a terminal return consumes no further budget

wasm.parameters: live enum ordinals only; erased parameters omitted

output_policy: The compiler opens the requested output only after complete checking and bounded emission; semantic failure and exhaustion leave existing output untouched. File-write failures are HostFailure and may leave an incomplete file, never a Built result. Callers must use the exit status, not file presence, as evidence of a fresh artifact.
external_argument_domain: Each live evaluator ordinal must designate a nullary constructor of its declared type; eval-cli reports HostFailure structured-argument for fielded constructor ordinals. The Node adapter accepts only enum-signatured host calls: live arity and profile-wide 0..255 are checked, while declared signature and per-type domain remain caller preconditions.
later_milestones: broader recursion beyond first-parameter field descent

structural_recursion.rule: First checked self-call argument must be a Reference to a strict field descendant of parameter 0; matches propagate descendant levels.
structural_recursion.forward_and_mutual_calls: Unchanged; live forward calls are Invalid check forward-live-call.

structural_terms.patterns: flat constructors with plain or + field binders
structural_terms.observation: Live-field projection, declaration order; erased fields omitted

fields_wasm.arguments: source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]
fields_wasm.budgets: Same defaults and maximum overrides as compiler; profile selection is explicit.
fields_wasm.enum_entry_unchanged: src/compile-cli.bend calls emit, which selects Enum{} and retains enum_profile rejection.
fields_wasm.enum_only_book_bytes: Identical to knot-enum-1; 25 frozen module hashes checked in both compiler lanes.

representation.fielded_type: i32 address of [tag][live fields in declaration order], one 4-byte word each
representation.zero_address: Valid cell address, not a null sentinel

arena.guard: unsigned size > 65536 - bump; only unreachable in the profile
arena.allocation: Arguments saved before allocation; stores after bounded pointer advance
arena.lifetime: Instance lifetime; immutable initialized cells; no free, reset, growth or reclamation

fields_wasm.exports: All original functions, unchanged indices; allocator appended and unexported; no memory or global exports.
fields_wasm.host_precondition: Checked Knot module of selected profile; invoke only enum-only live parameter/result signatures with valid per-type ordinals. Structured functions are for compiled callers. Adapter cannot enforce signature provenance.

host_outcomes.node_startup_failure: Outside adapter classification; not a successful execution

fields_wasm.proof_boundary: Five checked capability/representation/erasure helper laws, not general compiler or memory refinement.

knot_image.selection: Explicit only: compile-cli --profile=knot-image-1. The default profile and its arguments are unchanged; any other --profile= value is HostFailure arguments unknown-profile.
knot_image.encoder: src/image.bend (erasure and the entry), src/image-plan.bend (the plan and shared limits), src/image-layout.bend (words and the chunk stream), src/image-decode.bend (the decoder)
knot_image.arguments: --profile=knot-image-1 source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]
knot_image.budget_note: Raised for this profile only. The default profile keeps 65536 characters and 1048576 output bytes. The characters default admits base.bend (67190 characters). emitter_depth bounds the encoder's recursion: one source nesting level costs several steps, so its default and maximum are the largest Nat the budget parser accepts.
knot_image.limit_outcome: Exhausted compile budget, exit 4, before the output is opened; a failing compile leaves an existing output untouched.
knot_image.output: The image is written in chunks of at most 65536 bytes by File.write_bytes; no byte list of the whole image exists. The output is opened only after the whole image is laid out and fits.
knot_image.representation_types: None are declared: this base accepts no Base import, so header words 12..23 are none.
knot_image.term_match: src/image.bend::lower is an exhaustive match over the eight C.Term constructors with no wildcard; Branch outside a Case and Sequence are InternalFailure compile.
forms_after_the_merge_wave: Literal, Intrinsic, Default and keys-mode Case (literals)
representation words and the constants pool (modules and literals)
knot_image.codec: image-decode.decode inverts image-layout.layout over all thirteen opcodes; tests/compiler-image/image-cli.bend decode|recode is the test driver.
knot_image.names: A name is an identifier: one Char or more, each a byte of 1..127. layout refuses a plan with another name as Unsupported compile image-name (exit 3) before any word exists; decode reads no other.
knot_image.frozen_sources: tests/compiler-image/expectations.json lists its 690 sources explicitly and freezes only the image of each book check-cli accepts; a source check-cli refuses is held to a live check-cli of the same run. tests/compiler-image/seed-audit.json records the pinned seed's verdict on every Invalid source (83 rejected, 17 D4 gaps, not judged).
knot_image.round_trip_law: Partial correctness: for every fuel and book, encode(fuel,book) == Done(w) -> decode(w) == erase_tokens(fuel,book). The first statement, recoded == erase_tokens at every fuel, is false (layout needs more fuel than erasure and refuses past the limits and for names that decode does not read); its counterexamples are closed laws. Twenty-four checked laws on ground books and plans, quantified over every source position (src/image-LAWS.bend, src/image-PROOF.bend); the law over all books and fuels is an open obligation under D21, true as stated and unproved, stated in src/image-OPEN.bend, instantiated by the gate at 13 fuels and books, recorded in the trust inventory of src/SPEC.md and reviewed in tests/compiler-image/LAW_REVIEW.md.
